name: ToolCall
doc: A tool call requested by the model.

fields.name: input
doc: Parsed arguments, or the original string when `invalid` is true and the
provider input was not valid JSON.

fields.name: providerExecuted
doc: Whether the tool call will be executed by the provider.

fields.name: dynamic
doc: Whether the tool is dynamic (defined at runtime, e.g. MCP tools).

fields.name: providerMetadata
doc: Additional provider-specific metadata associated with this call.

fields.name: invalid
doc: Set when lookup, JSON parsing, or schema validation still failed after

fields.name: error
doc: Typed failure associated with an invalid tool call.
